resources.string: A month starts on the date of your choice and lasts one month, for example from 25 October to 24 November, to match your payday.

Sign in to iCloud in the Settings app to keep your months and transactions on all your devices. You can export them as a spreadsheet at any time.
Split your take-home pay into Needs, Wants and Savings and Debts. Trente sorts every transaction into one of them.
Think of it as the money you\'re free to spend each month, after tax.
You haven\'t opened Trente since %1$s, so reminders are paused. Open the app at any time to turn them back on.
Your months and transactions stay on this device. Trente has no account and no server. You can export them as a spreadsheet at any time.
Your months and transactions sync through your iCloud account on all your devices. Trente has no account and no server. You can export them as a spreadsheet at any time.
